comment: Reserved at generation time; never enters training data (F4/R5, and .claude/plans/archive/task-families.md for the decision families). Each family reserves an instance of its own: the dungeon and the house for family A, the coursebuilder app for family C, the scheduling probe for family G, the boatyard recipe tree for the crafting world and " after you" missions for the rooms world (.claude/plans/borrowed-worlds.md), and the telecom domain for the tau2-bench service worlds.
